description: Live mNAV scoreboard for the major public Bitcoin treasury companies (MSTR/Strategy, XXI/Twenty One, MPJPY/Metaplanet, ASST/Strive). Gross mNAV = market cap ÷ value of BTC held · below 1.0 means the stock trades under the value of its bitcoin. Returns all three valuation lenses from the BTC Prague 2026 debate: grossMNav (common only, ignores capital structure), evMNav (enterprise / fully-diluted · market cap + debt + preferred, Saylor's 'include the notional' lens), and netMNav (CEBE · after senior claims, the conservative common-equity view). Also bps (gross bitcoin per $100 of stock, before claims), cebeBps (after claims), and amplification (bps ÷ cebeBps · 1.0 means no senior leverage, higher means more). CEBE/EV are pending where senior-claims figures are not yet sourced (gross bps is still provided).
